globalInvariants: Target-led backward lexicon: Stories 1–3 are the source of the exact 100–150 bootstrap core vocabulary; never derive beginner vocabulary from arbitrary frequency lists.
Pure exposure: roughly 100–150 core words receive roughly 4–6 multisensory presentations each, totaling roughly 500–600 explicit exposures before recall testing or SRS review unlocks.
Button-free Zen minimalism: no Anki grading buttons, no persistent Continue button bars, no XP/streaks/dashboards/status colors; natural tap-anywhere cadence is the primary interaction.
System chooses one experience: no learner-facing course/level/deck/catalog selection, ranked recommendations, or algorithm rationale.
Offline-first/privacy: core loop works locally/offline; domain learning logic is pure Dart; learner persistence is bounded aggregates with no append-only behavioral log; no behavioral telemetry.
One tokenizer and one shared Token representation serve reader, content, selector, acquisition, review, dictionary, and future importer.
Selector and review remain separate; SRS state is owned by review and learner knowledge by the learner model.
Media are optional capabilities of content; no universal sentence-audio synchronization layer is required.
Completed content remains accessible; rereading uses current learner state and preserves reading position.
Developer level injection is a test/bootstrap hook only: --dart-define=LEVEL=0..100; it never becomes a learner-facing level system.
